races.paceDynamic: Tales Of Wisdom and Queen's Companion will contest the early lead, with Tales Of Wisdom showing more recent pace-setting form and likely to dictate terms. The field splits into clear pace-setters versus hold-up horses, with limited prominent runners to bridge the gap. This creates a tactical race where the leaders can control fractions before the back markers launch their challenge. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the genuine pace and finish fastest when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Tales Of Wisdom and Queen's Companion engage early and soften each other up
scenarios.body: The pace-setters create ideal conditions for closers to pick up the pieces in the final furlong. Quartermaster and the lightly-raced newcomers benefit most from this setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If Tales Of Wisdom gets an uncontested lead and controls the fractions
scenarios.body: The Charlie Appleby runner can dictate a more sedate pace and have enough left to resist late challenges. Queen's Companion lacks recent form to mount serious pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapse benefits
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too hard early and tie up dramatically in the final quarter
scenarios.body: The moderate hold-up horses get handed the race as the class runners falter. Bemersyde and King Cherry can pick up the pieces at generous odds.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightly raced upsets
scenarios.trigger: If the newcomers Cuff It or I Got Rhythm possess hidden ability on debut improvement
scenarios.body: One of the unraced runners exploits the tactical nature and superior fitness to land a shock result. The form horses underestimate the newcomers' potential.

watchPoints.text: Tales Of Wisdom and Queen's Companion could set suicidal fractions if both determined to lead early
Quartermaster's 155-day absence might leave him short of peak fitness despite his superior class
The three apprentice riders on Queen's Companion, Bemersyde and King Cherry could impact tactical decisions
Cuff It and I Got Rhythm are complete unknowns who could possess significant hidden ability
Bemersyde carries 7lb less than the main dangers which provides a significant tactical advantage

runners_data.name: Pride Of Donegal

runners_data.name: Arqoob
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist perfectly suited to strong pace scenario but faces fitness questions after 167-day absence

runners_data.name: Marnier
runners_data.note: Front-runner from powerful Gosden stable with proven course form but needs to survive early pace pressure

runners_data.name: Ernst Blofeld
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from long break with trainer having poor recent strike rate raising fitness doubts

runners_data.name: Master Vintner
runners_data.note: Natural leader with course-winning form but 188-day layoff creates stamina questions at this testing trip

runners_data.name: Topteam
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner in excellent form with strong recent course record and top jockey booking

runners_data.name: Double Meaning
runners_data.note: Prominent runner well-handicapped but longest absence of field and trainer's poor recent form creates concerns

races.paceDynamic: Pride Of Donegal, Marnier, Master Vintner and Topteam will all want to lead, creating a fierce early battle that will establish a strong gallop from the off. The pace will be genuinely testing over this stamina-sapping 1m4f trip, with four confirmed front-runners unwilling to settle. This sustained pace battle will stretch the field and create a true test of stamina in the closing stages. The strong early gallop heavily favours hold-up horses and those with proven stamina reserves who can finish strongly when others weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the four leaders engage in a sustained speed duel through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will take its toll on the pace-setters, creating perfect conditions for a late closer to sweep past tiring leaders. Arqoob's hold-up style and proven stamina over similar trips makes him ideally positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders can steal a march and get first run on his rivals
scenarios.body: Despite the pace pressure, a front-runner with tactical speed could kick clear before the closers get organized. Topteam's recent form and Oisin Murphy's tactical nous could see him dictate terms from the front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly unsustainable and creates gaps for prominent runners
scenarios.body: The speed battle could become so fierce that horses tracking just behind the leaders get the perfect trip. Asgard's Captain and Ernst Blofeld could benefit from sitting off the main pace battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders surprisingly settle and avoid early confrontation
scenarios.body: Without genuine pace pressure, the race could become more tactical and favor horses with tactical speed. This scenario seems unlikely given the number of confirmed front-runners.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Pride Of Donegal and Topteam clash for the early lead as both are confirmed pace-setters who may not settle
Monitor Ernst Blofeld's fitness after 288-day break as his early position could be crucial in strong pace scenario
Check if Arqoob travels smoothly in rear given his long absence but ideal racing style for expected pace scenario
Observe if Master Vintner shows early pace given his front-running style but fitness concerns after long layoff
Watch for market support for Double Meaning despite trainer concerns as he's well-treated by handicapper

races.paceDynamic: Blue Samuna will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure from the prominent runners. Tamzan, Crazee Icon, Daretobedifferent and Safe Harbor will track in the second rank, while the hold-up merchants Dream Illusion, Bearin Up, Khuskhas and India Gold will need the pace to develop strongly in the final three furlongs. With only one horse committed to making the running and several prominent types happy to sit off the pace, this sets up as a tactical affair that will favour horses who can finish strongly from off the pace rather than those needing a truly-run gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Tempo Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Samuna sets a steady pace with the prominent horses content to wait
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure creates a stop-start rhythm that plays into the hands of horses with a decisive finishing kick. Hold-up types get the perfect scenario to unleash their best efforts in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the second-rank runners apply enough pressure to Blue Samuna from the three-furlong pole
scenarios.body: This creates an honest gallop that suits horses racing prominently who can quicken off a solid tempo. The hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground against this more testing pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Blue Samuna Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Samuna gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the front runner to build an unassailable advantage. Those tracking struggle to respond quickly enough to a horse who has conserved energy throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a dash from the two-furlong marker
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test in the final quarter-mile where positioning and a clean run matter more than stamina. Horses with natural gate speed but tactical speed hold the edge.

watchPoints.text: Blue Samuna getting an uncontested lead through the first half-mile could make her very hard to peg back
Dream Illusion and Bearin Up both need the pace to develop strongly or they'll have too much ground to make up
Crazee Icon with Oisin Murphy aboard represents stable and jockey combinations in excellent current form
India Gold returning from nearly five months off makes her fitness levels completely unknown
Tamzan has been knocking on the door in similar contests and the consistent profile makes her a reliable each-way option

races.paceDynamic: Sir Edward Lear is the only confirmed front runner with prominent tendencies, likely to set a sustainable pace without pressure from fellow pace-setters. Sansanetti may join him early given his prominent style, but the bulk of the field - A Major Payne, Caph Star, Expressionless, Beach Point, Salaria, and Caledonian - all prefer to be held up. This creates a tactical race where the front pair can dictate terms without being hassled through the early stages. The abundance of hold-up horses suggests they'll be fighting over limited racing room in the straight, clearly favoring those able to get first run or positioned prominently throughout.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Sir Edward Lear and Sansanetti set modest fractions without early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace-setters control the race completely and kick clear when the hold-up brigade are still finding their stride. Those who can travel strongly behind the leaders benefit from the perfect setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Jam Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get bunched together approaching the straight
scenarios.body: Six horses needing room at the same time creates inevitable trouble and those getting clear runs early prosper. The prominent runners avoid the melee and capitalize on superior positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Galloper Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace lifts significantly in the final three furlongs
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop finds out those without stamina reserves and rewards horses with proven staying power at this trip. Late thrust becomes crucial as the early pace takes its toll.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses gets a dream run through
scenarios.body: Perfect positioning and timing allows a held-up runner to exploit the tactical nature with devastating late kick. The front runners pay for their early exertions when challenged decisively.

watchPoints.text: Sir Edward Lear could exploit his tactical advantage completely if handling the return from his lengthy 225-day absence
Traffic problems are inevitable with six hold-up horses needing room simultaneously in the home straight
Sansanetti's weight advantage could prove decisive if his fitness holds up after the extended break
Both Expressionless and Caledonian have jockey changes to inexperienced riders which could affect their tactical execution
Beach Point with Oisin Murphy represents the most dangerous of the hold-up horses if getting a clear passage

races.name: Behind The Bridle Racehorse Aftercare Handicap

runners_data.name: We're Goosers
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with Oisin Murphy aboard for in-form Palmer stable, suits the likely honest pace but needs to prove 7f effectiveness after mixed recent form.

runners_data.name: Gizmo
runners_data.note: Natural hold-up horse returning from 229-day break for Bell, classy profile suggests fitness concerns but race fitness less crucial in small field scenario.

runners_data.name: Just A Girl
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner with solid 7f winning form, likely pace pressure from Wield creates tactical complications but Charlie Johnston horses often battle gamely.

runners_data.name: Deluded
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer carrying light weight for effective Fellowes yard, honest gallop should suit but needs to prove she can pick up the pieces from the back.

runners_data.name: Magic Box
runners_data.note: Haggas-trained closer returning after 225-day absence, high-class profile suggests ability remains but ring-rustiness poses obvious fitness questions.

runners_data.name: Wield
runners_data.note: Second front runner creates pace dynamics, improving form line suggests competitive spirit but may lack tactical speed to respond when challenged by classier rivals.

races.paceDynamic: Just A Girl and Wield will contest the early lead in this small field, with Just A Girl showing more natural pace and likely to secure the front running position. The dual pace angle creates an honest gallop through the middle stages, preventing either leader from getting an easy time. With three hold-up horses (Gizmo, Deluded, Magic Box) and only We're Goosers tracking prominently, the pace pressure should be sustainable rather than destructive. This race shape strongly favours the prominent tracker and hold-up horses who can benefit from the honest pace and finish strongly up the Newmarket hill.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Just A Girl and Wield maintain steady fractions without killing each other
scenarios.body: The honest pace sets up perfectly for the three closers to unleash finishing kicks, with Gizmo's class edge and Magic Box's Haggas polish coming to the fore. The 7f trip on good ground allows patient tactics to flourish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If We're Goosers positions perfectly behind the dueling leaders
scenarios.body: Murphy can track the pace battle and strike at the optimal moment when the front two begin to tire, using superior tactical speed to bridge past weakening leaders. The 7f distance suits this patient-aggressive approach perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Just A Girl gets soft sectionals and the chasers fail to organize
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate terms and find enough in reserve when challenged, especially with her proven 7f winning form. The small field works in her favour by reducing traffic problems.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and completely capitulate
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawl and turns into a sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can win. Magic Box's proven sprint speed becomes the decisive factor.

watchPoints.text: Just A Girl must handle pressure from Wield early without compromising her finishing kick - if she gets into speed battle she becomes vulnerable
Gizmo and Magic Box both returning from 200+ day breaks - watch market confidence and paddock appearance for fitness clues
We're Goosers' positioning behind the leaders crucial - Murphy needs to avoid getting trapped on heels when pace quickens
Small field means limited cover for hold-up horses - closers need luck in running to unleash finishing kicks effectively
Charlie Johnston 3lb claimer Jack Callan takes valuable weight off Just A Girl but watch for tactical inexperience in pace battle

runners_data.name: Angels' Share

races.paceDynamic: Angels' Share, Victor Cee and Akabusi will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. Victor Cee has proven ability to make all after winning at Hamilton, while Angels' Share showed front-running prowess in his dual wins at Wolverhampton. The sustained pace over 6f on good ground will test stamina reserves in the final furlong. This honest gallop strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish fastest when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too fast early and tie up in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will find out the leaders' stamina, allowing closers with tactical speed to sweep past. Southern Warrior, King Of Chaos and Ecclefechan are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Victor Cee Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Victor Cee can dictate fractions and kick clear like at Hamilton
scenarios.body: His proven front-running ability gives him tactical advantage over the other leaders, and Phil McEntee's horses often improve for stable confidence. The 23-day break should have him sharp enough to sustain his gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is honest but not destructive, allowing prominent racers to time their move
scenarios.body: Nebulon and Daizen can track the leaders without getting involved in early speed battles. Both have enough tactical pace to strike when positioned handy to the speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Angels' Share or Akabusi can steal a march while the others fight
scenarios.body: The least likely scenario requires perfect pace judgment from Saffie Osborne or the returning Angels' Share. Both have shown front-running ability but face stronger pace pressure here.

watchPoints.text: Angels' Share confirmed non-runner eliminates one front-runner but still leaves Victor Cee and Akabusi to ensure strong pace
Watch for Victor Cee's early position as his ability to dictate fractions could determine whether he survives or ties up late
Southern Warrior needs Liam Wright to secure cover behind the pace battle rather than getting too far back in a small field
Oisin Murphy's booking of Ecclefechan suggests stable confidence in this hold-up horse's chances from an honest gallop
Monitor the early fractions as three confirmed front-runners in a 10-runner field should create perfect conditions for closers
